headline.text: L3 ML4 held 8 cases for *blooming* at startup Monday morning — resolved after operator adjustments, product now acceptable.

summary: One active quality hold. Two sanitation gaps flagged: S3 left with product residue on floor and S4 metal detector uncleaned at shift handoff. Bent plow component at ML4 warrants follow-up for potential metal generation.

holds.title: 8 cases held for blooming appearance
holds.summary: ML4 startup Monday produced bars with blooming; 8 cases isolated pending QA disposition, appearance corrected after operator adjustments.

food_safety.title: Bent plow component at ML4
food_safety.summary: Back-off plow piece found bent at 08:06; warrants inspection for potential metal shavings or blade damage entering product zone.
food_safety.status: Open — Shawn Jewkes flagged for Blake Heward to schedule detachment and straightening.

quality.title: ML2 belt cooler found off at shift handoff
quality.summary: Second-shift operator Jacob found belt cooler off upon receiving the line at 14:53; turned on immediately.
quality.status: Resolved — cooler restarted, product temp monitoring confirmed in-spec.

quality.title: S4 center caramel line sticking at cutter
quality.summary: Center caramel pieces exiting cutter stuck together at 11:08; operator inspecting and removing damaged pieces inline.
quality.status: Open — operator monitoring and culling, root cause not yet identified.

quality.title: ML3 cream viscosity out of spec
quality.summary: All batched cream measured viscosity too high at 17:38; line paused to batch fresh cream meeting spec.
quality.status: Resolved — fresh cream batched and line resumed within shift.

quality.title: ML4 broken bars at demolding
quality.summary: Bars breaking at demolding (not gondola); maintenance adjusted table after mold turner at 11:13, monitoring continued.
quality.status: Resolved after adjustment — Jenny Medina confirmed no broken bars observed post-fix.

quality.title: 160 damaged caddies discarded
quality.summary: Two full boxes (80 ea) of item caddies arrived damaged and unusable; Ethan Bean notified for supplier follow-up.

quality.title: ML1 Cavanna 2 centerline points OOS
quality.summary: Flow-wrap operator posted 2 data points outside centerline at 14:04; adjustments made to center film and avoid scrap.
quality.status: Resolved — operator adjusted wrapper, film now centered.

sanitation.title: S4 metal detector left uncleaned from 1st shift
sanitation.summary: Second-shift operator posted photo at 07:11 showing metal detector belt area not cleaned during 1st-shift handoff.
sanitation.status: Resolved — second shift cleaned before startup.

sanitation.title: S3 line left with product residue
sanitation.summary: Mary Montilla inspection found floor of top matrices and bucket area unclean — pieces of last product and chocolate on floor and stairs.
sanitation.status: Open — Conner Boyd notified, cleaning required before next run.

opportunities.text: Review metal detector cleaning protocol at S4 — today's shift-handoff gap suggests checklist enforcement or signoff verification may be needed.
Consider adding line-cleanliness inspection to S3 shutdown checklist — Charity's report of product residue and chocolate on floor/stairs indicates end-of-shift cleaning not completed to standard.
Review belt cooler status verification at ML2 shift handoff — today's cooler found off suggests equipment state checklist may need enhancement.
Consider adding cleaning-roller blade inspection to ML4 startup checklist — today's bent back-off plow piece and possible metal shavings echo concerns about equipment integrity in product zones.
